newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ProSource started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ProSource started at buy.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of ProSource Inc with a buy recommendation and a price target of $16 a share over the next 12 months.

-- Rodman said it added ProSource to its coverage of the foodservice distribution industry in anticipation of management creating an environment of profits through aggressive cost controls and investments aimed at maintaining operating margins.
-- Rodman believes ProSource will build investor confidence and enthusiasm as positive quarterly results are reported.
-- Its shares were trading up 7/16 at 12-5/16.
